edits.new: Use the complete post to interpret the meaning of the fragments. Describe what the fragments together specify about the post and what they leave unspecified. Do not fill in unspecified meaning from the complete post. This describes the mask’s class of possible posts: they share the specified meaning but can differ in the unspecified aspects. Identify what the complete post specifies that the mask leaves unspecified; this is the meaning missing from the mask.
edits.old: Use the complete post to interpret the meaning of the fragments. Identify alternative posts consistent with the meaning represented by the fragments together but differing in some of the complete post’s meaning. These differences identify meaning missing from the mask.

edits.new: Return only a JSON object with three fields: "post_class" (a brief description of the class, not example posts), "missing_meaning" (a brief description of the meaning missing from the mask), and "prominence" (the integer score).
edits.old: Return only a JSON object with one integer field, "prominence".
